ios.desc:
Your news. Your sources. No ads. No algorithms. Just the stories that matter to you, from 16,000+ publishers worldwide.

Newsreadeck puts you in control of your news diet. Choose from 16,000+ curated sources — newspapers, magazines, and blogs from around the world — and read them in a clean, distraction-free reader. No sponsored articles. No paywalls. No noise.

▸ AI-POWERED SUMMARIES
Get the key points of any article in seconds. AI summaries run entirely on your device — private, fast, and available in multiple languages. Read less, understand more.

▸ INSTANT TRANSLATION
Read news from any country in your language. Translate full articles or AI summaries with one tap — perfect for staying informed on global stories.

▸ LISTEN TO YOUR NEWS
Turn any article into audio with built-in text-to-speech. Catch up on the news while commuting, cooking, or working out.

▸ DISTRACTION-FREE READING
Our custom reader strips away ads, pop-ups, and clutter. Just clean text and images — the way reading should be.

▸ SMART FILTERING
Mute words and topics you don't want to see. Your feed shows only what matters to you.

▸ SAVE & ORGANIZE
Bookmark articles for later. Export them to your favorite apps. Build your personal news library.

▸ WIDGETS & NOTIFICATIONS
Home screen widgets for instant access to headlines. Push notifications when breaking stories drop — you'll never miss what matters.

▸ CROSS-DEVICE SYNC
Start reading on your iPhone, continue on your iPad. Your feeds, saved articles, and preferences follow you everywhere.

▸ 16,000+ CURATED SOURCES
From The New York Times to niche tech blogs, from BBC to local community papers. Add any RSS feed — if it publishes, Newsreadeck delivers it.

▸ AVAILABLE IN 7 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Russian.

Download Newsreadeck and take back control of how you read the news.

We'd love to hear your feedback. Contact our support team through the app in Settings > Suggest.
Have questions or problems? Email us at support@newsreadeck.com

quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What newspaper are you paying for these days?

quotes.text:
Hello HN!,

For the past three years, I have been developing a news aggregator app called Newsreadeck. I like to read news from several sources. However, most similar apps are primarily available in English and cater to U.S. users.

I initially tried using RSS feeds, but many websites don't offer them. Manually creating or finding RSS feeds was tedious. Additionally, RSS feeds often just opened articles in a web browser or displayed only snippets, not the full content.

To address these issues, I developed my own data sources. I've compiled over 16,000 curated sources, categorized by language, location, and topic, which I monitor for reliability. The app allows you to discover and follow sources without limits and access articles seamlessly. I also built a custom reader to remove ads, banners, and distractions, although some paywalls may still appear.

Some sources can be too aggressive in publishing articles. To address this, I've added options to mute certain words to avoid related articles, mute specific sources, and create a custom news feed by grouping your favorite sources.

The app features a search engine that allows users to apply filters such as language, country, and topic in addition to keywords, helping them discover top news and new channels to explore.

Finally, the app features widgets that bring the latest news straight to your home screen.

If you're as enthusiastic about news as I am, you're welcome to try out the app, available on the App Store.
